name: build-system:check
description: Run all Python format, lint, and type checks plus workflow lint and the dispatch-coherence guard (ruff + pyrefly + actionlint)

name: build:cli:collaboration:dev
description: Build the debug accelerator-collaboration sub-binary (cli/target/debug/accelerator-collaboration)

name: build:cli:corpus:dev
description: Build the debug accelerator-corpus sub-binary (cli/target/debug/accelerator-corpus)

name: build:cli:cross-compile
description: Cross-compile the cli launcher + verify shim for all four release targets (stages into dist/release/)

name: build:cli:design:dev
description: Build the debug accelerator-design sub-binary (cli/target/debug/accelerator-design)

name: build:cli:dev
description: Build the debug cli launcher (cli/target/debug/accelerator) the test suites invoke through ACCELERATOR_BIN

name: build:cli:fixture-size
description: Assert the host-native VCS reference artefact links its gix/jj-lib trees (ratio floor; the absolute floor is musl-only and runs in the cross-compile)

name: build:cli:jira:dev
description: Build the debug accelerator-jira sub-binary (cli/target/debug/accelerator-jira)

name: build:cli:linear:dev
description: Build the debug accelerator-linear sub-binary (cli/target/debug/accelerator-linear)

name: build:cli:migrate:dev
description: Build the debug accelerator-migrate sub-binary (cli/target/debug/accelerator-migrate)

name: build:cli:research:dev
description: Build the debug accelerator-research sub-binary (cli/target/debug/accelerator-research)

name: build:cli:vcs:dev
description: Build the debug accelerator-vcs sub-binary (cli/target/debug/accelerator-vcs)

name: build:cli:work:dev
description: Build the debug accelerator-work sub-binary (cli/target/debug/accelerator-work)

name: build:debug-archives
description: Create .debug.tar.gz archives for all cross-compiled release binaries

name: build:frontend
description: Build the visualiser frontend (Vite production build into dist/)

name: build:frontend:stub
description: Write a placeholder frontend/dist/index.html if absent (satisfies embed-dist build.rs for lint-only compiles; not a real build; real build:frontend overwrites it)

name: build:server:cross-compile
description: Cross-compile the visualiser server for all four release targets

name: build:server:dev
description: Build the visualiser server binary with the dev-frontend feature

name: build:server:release
description: Build the frontend, then the visualiser server binary for release (embed-dist; the frontend build overwrites any lint-stub dist/index.html)

name: build:vendor-verify-shims
description: Copy the cross-compiled verify shims into the committed bin/ tree and record the drift marker

name: check
description: Run all read-only format, lint, and type checks (what CI runs)

name: cli:check
description: Run all cli/ workspace format and lint checks (workspace-wide rustfmt + clippy + vendored-shim drift guard; read-only, no tests)

name: default
description: Full local CI mirror: build, format-fix, lint, type-check, deny/pup static checks, docs gate, test (heavy — reformats in place, compiles Rust several times, needs network + Chromium; for a fast inner loop use a single <component>:check)

name: deny:check
description: Check the cli/ workspace dependency graph with cargo-deny (advisories, licenses, bans, sources)

name: deps:install:cargo-about
description: Provision the pinned cargo-about (built from source on stable; its 0.9.x release binaries omit x86_64-apple-darwin, so a ubi pin would break mise install on the Intel-mac leg)

name: deps:install:cargo-sources
description: Populate the cli/ cargo registry for offline cargo-about and cargo-deny runs

name: deps:install:docs
description: Install Node.js dependencies for the documentation site

name: deps:install:docs-playwright
description: Install the Chromium binary the docs mermaid render needs

name: deps:install:nightly
description: Provision the pinned nightly toolchain shared by every nightly-lane build step (rustup-managed, not a mise [tool] — mise cannot pin two rust toolchains)

name: deps:install:node
description: Install Node.js dependencies for the visualiser frontend

name: deps:install:playwright
description: Install Playwright browser binaries (Chromium + OS-level deps)

name: deps:install:public-api
description: Provision the pinned cargo-public-api (built on stable; needs the nightly only for the rustdoc it shells out to at check time)

name: deps:install:pup
description: Provision the pinned cargo-pup (built under the nightly: its rustc_private driver only loads under the toolchain it was compiled against)

name: deps:install:python
description: Install all Python dependencies

name: deps:install:rust-components
description: Install the rustfmt + clippy + llvm-tools-preview rustup components the cli checks need (mise [tools] `components` is not honoured for an already-present toolchain)

name: deps:install:rust-targets
description: Install Rust cross-compile targets required for release builds

name: dev
description: Start + supervise the visualiser server + frontend, detached in the background (use dev:stop to tear down; dev:server/dev:frontend for the manual two-terminal flow)

name: dev:frontend
description: Start the Vite frontend dev server proxying /api to dev:server (start dev:server first)

name: dev:restart
description: Restart the supervised dev stack (stop then start)

name: dev:server
description: Start the visualiser API server in dev mode (run alongside dev:frontend in a second terminal)

name: dev:status
description: Report dev server + frontend state, frontend URL, and resolved API port (exit 0 = both running, 3 = one, 4 = neither)

name: dev:stop
description: Stop the supervised dev server + frontend and the circus arbiter

name: docs:audit:check
description: Fail on high/critical npm advisories in the docs-site tree

name: docs:audit:fix
description: Apply npm's non-breaking advisory fixes to the docs-site lockfile

name: docs:build
description: Build the documentation site (strict: broken links fail the build)

name: docs:check
description: Docs gate: strict site build incl. link validation + npm audit (CI-owned; needs network + Chromium)

name: docs:generate
description: Generate per-skill reference pages from SKILL.md sources

name: docs:generate:check
description: Verify every plugin.json skill has a generated docs page

name: docs:preview
description: Serve the built documentation site from docs-site/dist (run docs:build first)

name: docs:serve
description: Serve the documentation site locally with live reload

name: eval:ask-and-report
description: Run the ask-and-report behavioural eval: 111 multi-turn headless claude sessions consulting a reference corpus (needs claude, network and model usage, and the dev CLI builds)

name: eval:citing-once
description: Run the citing-once behavioural eval: headless claude sessions composing findings and dossiers, judged against a reading of the rule (needs claude, network and model usage; ~10 min at the default 6 sessions at once)

name: fix
description: Apply all formatters + safe lint fixes (MECHANICAL only — no type-checks, and shell has no autofixer; still run `mise run check` before pushing)

name: format:build-system:check
description: Check Python formatting with ruff (read-only; fails on drift)

name: format:build-system:fix
description: Format Python in place with ruff

name: format:check
description: Run all format checks (read-only)

name: format:cli:check
description: Check cli/ workspace Rust formatting with rustfmt (read-only; fails on drift)

name: format:cli:fix
description: Format the cli/ workspace in place with rustfmt

name: format:fix
description: Apply all formatters in place

name: format:frontend:check
description: Check frontend formatting with Biome (read-only)

name: format:frontend:fix
description: Format the frontend in place with Biome

name: format:scripts:check
description: Check shell formatting with shfmt (read-only; fails on drift)

name: format:scripts:fix
description: Format shell scripts in place with shfmt

name: format:server:check
description: Check Rust formatting with rustfmt (cargo fmt --check)

name: format:server:fix
description: Format Rust in place (cargo fmt)

name: frontend:check
description: Run all frontend format, lint, and type checks (Biome + tsc)

name: git:check-clean
description: Abort if the working tree has any uncommitted changes

name: github:check-auth
description: Verify the GitHub CLI is authenticated

name: keys:generate
description: Generate a -W release signing keypair (writes keys/accelerator-release.{pub,sec}; does not print the secret)

name: lint:bare-invocation:check
description: Guard the bare accelerator invocation convention across skills/**/SKILL.md (no plugin-root /bin prefix, absolute path, or bash/sh/env wrapper)

name: lint:build-system:check
description: Lint Python with ruff (select = ALL)

name: lint:build-system:fix
description: Apply ruff's safe lint fixes to Python

name: lint:check
description: Run all lint checks

name: lint:claude-coupling:check
description: Guard the rename set (cli/, bin/accelerator, the dev-env writers) against naming any CLAUDE_* variable

name: lint:cli:check
description: Lint the cli/ workspace with clippy (one workspace-wide pass covering every member, -D warnings)

name: lint:cli:fix
description: Apply clippy's machine-applicable fixes to the cli/ workspace (machine-rewritable subset only — run lint:cli:check for the rest)

name: lint:config-test-support:check
description: Confine config/test-support to config's and config-adapters' dev-dependencies (no crate may enable or forward it otherwise)

name: lint:crate-dependencies:check
description: Hold every cli/ crate's normal and build dependencies to the injection rules, read from each manifest's [package.metadata.accelerator] role declaration

name: lint:dispatch-coherence:check
description: Bind every DISPATCHED_SUBBINARIES token to a SKILL.md that invokes it under a matching allowed-tools rule, and every skill invocation to a shipped token

name: lint:fix
description: Apply all safe lint fixes (shell has no autofixer — run `mise run scripts:check` for remaining shell findings)

name: lint:frontend:check
description: Lint the frontend with Biome (react+test+project, warnings-as-errors)

name: lint:frontend:fix
description: Apply Biome's safe lint fixes to the frontend

name: lint:git-tokens:check
description: Guard against a direct git subcommand in any skills/**/SKILL.md: the no-raw-git invariant, scoped to SKILL.md

name: lint:integration-skills:check
description: Guard the repointed integration skills: outcome-keyword parity against each sub-binary's declared set, and a confirm step before every write mutation

name: lint:scripts:bashisms:check
description: Guard the bash-3.2 floor (denylist of bash-4 constructs)

name: lint:scripts:check
description: Run all shell lint checks

name: lint:scripts:shellcheck:check
description: Lint shell scripts with ShellCheck (config in .shellcheckrc)

name: lint:server:check
description: Lint Rust with clippy, two feature passes, -D warnings (gated on a dist stub, not a full SPA build; still two cold compiles — slow on a cold cache)

name: lint:server:fix
description: Apply clippy's machine-applicable fixes (cargo clippy --fix, default features only — all-features/dev-frontend arms surface via server:check and may need manual fixes)

name: lint:skill-cli-refs:check
description: Bind every accelerator vcs <sub> skill reference to a real subcommand (pinned against the clap Command enum) and render-lock the detect.rs idiom anchors

name: lint:skill-permissions:check
description: Guard every SKILL.md !-preprocessor invocation against its allowed-tools rules (coverage, --fail-safe, no metacharacters, no bare-launcher grant) plus the injection census

name: lint:store-duplication:check
description: Keep atomic_write consolidated: no temp-and-rename outside cli/store/

name: lint:vcs-settings:check
description: Keep jj UserSettings and Workspace::load out of cli/vcs-adapters (their defaults are private to jj-lib)

name: lint:vendor-shims:check
description: Guard the committed verify shims against their cli/verify build inputs (drift marker + per-platform magic bytes)

name: lint:workflows
description: Lint GitHub Actions workflows with actionlint

name: lint:workflows:check
description: Lint GitHub Actions workflows with actionlint (general syntax hygiene; the queue/gate-placement invariants are guarded by tests/unit/tasks/test_workflows.py)

name: measure:build
description: Time a full default build: a priming run then N timed runs, per-task figures and host contention (macOS, ~20 min at --runs 3; writes .accelerator-measure/build/, --keep also writes meta/measurements/ unless a fetch failed)

name: measure:launcher-size
description: Report the stripped release launcher's byte size for aarch64-apple-darwin

name: measure:summary-latency
description: Time the SessionStart config summary, cold and warm, in git, jj and colocated jj (quiet host, same host before and after)

name: measure:teardown
description: Replay the measurement harness's restore and verify phases from a stale manifest

name: measure:warm-dispatch
description: Measure warm-dispatch latency vs the shell baseline (quiet host, network egress, ~8 min, up to ~30 min if the interval escalates)

name: notices:check
description: Pin the third-party notices artefact against a fresh dual-generator render (cargo-about + license-checker)

name: notices:update
description: Regenerate the third-party notices artefact from the cli/ closure and the frontend production tree

name: prerelease
description: Local dev only: full prerelease flow without SLSA attestation

name: prerelease:finalise
description: CI prerelease step 3: commit, tag, push, create release, upload, publish

name: prerelease:prepare
description: CI prerelease halve 1: bump version, build binaries, compute checksums

name: prerelease:sign
description: CI prerelease step 2: sign the staged binaries and emit the signed manifest (needs ACCELERATOR_RELEASE_SECRET_KEY)

name: public-api:check
description: Pin each named crate's public API against its committed snapshot with cargo-public-api (nightly lane: rustdoc emits its JSON only there)

name: public-api:update
description: Regenerate every pinned crate's public-API snapshot with cargo-public-api

name: pup:check
description: Enforce intra-crate module-import rules with cargo-pup (blocking nightly lane; ACCELERATOR_PUP_MODE=warn downgrades to advisory)

name: release
description: Local dev only: full stable release flow without SLSA attestation

name: release:finalise
description: CI stable release step 3: commit, tag, push, create release, upload, publish

name: release:prepare
description: CI stable release halve 1: finalise version, update marketplace and changelog, build binaries

name: release:sign
description: CI stable release step 2: sign the staged binaries and emit the signed manifest (needs ACCELERATOR_RELEASE_SECRET_KEY)

name: scripts:check
description: Run all shell format and lint checks (shfmt + ShellCheck + bashisms)

name: server:check
description: Run all Rust format and lint checks (rustfmt + clippy)

name: test
description: Run all tests in parallel

name: test:e2e
description: Run all E2E tests in parallel

name: test:e2e:visualiser
description: Run visualiser E2E tests (Playwright)

name: test:e2e:visualiser:docker
description: Run visual-regression specs in the pinned Playwright Docker image (compare)

name: test:e2e:visualiser:docker:update
description: Regenerate the canonical Linux visual-regression baselines in the pinned Docker image

name: test:integration
description: Run all integration tests in parallel

name: test:integration:arxiv-queue-stress
description: Run 30 concurrent arXiv fetches through the fair queue on the real clock (opt-in: minutes)

name: test:integration:conformance
description: Run the producer-conformance guard (drives the real corpus validator through the launcher)

name: test:integration:deny
description: Run the cargo-deny native-tls/OpenSSL ban regression (offline fixtures)

name: test:integration:design-automation
description: Run the Playwright-executor suites that need a real runtime (opt-in)

name: test:integration:dev
description: Run unified dev task integration tests (real circusd + Python fake processes)

name: test:integration:entrypoint
description: Run bin/accelerator entry-point tests (stubbed fetch, real minisign + verify shim)

name: test:integration:eval-fixtures
description: Run the ask-and-report reference corpus pre-flight: every variant validates, and every scenario reaches its declared gate and setup (debug launcher, corpus and research builds; no model)

name: test:integration:fixture-size
description: Roll-up entry point for the gix/jj-lib link-ratio floor; see build:cli:fixture-size

name: test:integration:hooks
description: Run hooks integration tests

name: test:integration:measure
description: Live-dispatch smoke check for the warm-dispatch harness (n=2, no gating figure)

name: test:integration:pup
description: Run the cargo-pup architecture regression (needs the nightly lane; check-architecture only, not the test roll-up)

name: test:integration:research
description: Run the research guard's lexer differential against real bash and zsh (fixed-seed mutant sample), and the academic profiles' invocations through the guard

name: test:integration:research-exhaustive
description: Run the research guard's lexer differential at every splice position (opt-in: minutes)

name: test:integration:skill-invocation
description: Extract every bin/accelerator config !-site command from skills/**/SKILL.md and run it through the real bootstrap with an empty environment

name: test:integration:tasks
description: Run pytest integration tests for invoke tasks

name: test:integration:tracker-contract
description: Run the RemoteTracker contract harness against a live tracker (opt-in: needs credentials, so it is out of the test:integration roll-up and out of default; filtered out of test:unit:cli by cli/.config/nextest.toml)

name: test:integration:visualiser
description: Run visualiser integration tests

name: test:unit
description: Run all unit tests in parallel

name: test:unit:cli
description: Run cli/ workspace tests via nextest with coverage folded in (report-only; ACCELERATOR_COVERAGE=off drops to plain nextest)

name: test:unit:design-automation
description: Run the runtime-free Playwright-executor JavaScript suites

name: test:unit:frontend
description: Run visualiser frontend unit tests (Vitest)

name: test:unit:frontend-licenses
description: Guard that every module in the built frontend bundle resolves to the --production licence closure (its own sourcemap build; no shipped dist/ dependency)

name: test:unit:tasks
description: Run pytest unit tests for invoke tasks

name: test:unit:vcs
description: Run pytest unit tests for the VCS test-support fixtures (cross-engine mask parity)

name: test:unit:visualiser
description: Run visualiser unit tests

name: types:build-system:check
description: Type-check Python with pyrefly (strict preset)

name: types:check
description: Run all type checks (tsc + pyrefly)

name: types:frontend:check
description: Type-check the frontend with tsc (tsc -b --noEmit)

name: vendor:assemble-tree-artifacts
description: Assemble the driver/browser tree archives from the verified upstream inputs

name: vendor:build-archive
description: Build one deterministic tree archive and its attestation from a tree dir (cross-language contract test helper)

name: vendor:check-trust-anchors
description: Fail if the vendored runtime's trust anchors (pins, publisher keys) are still placeholders

name: vendor:guard-pins
description: Report runtime-pin-guard findings for the vendored-runtime pins and keyring (networked; prints drafts unless --open-issues)

name: vendor:smoke-runtime
description: Execute the downloaded tree binaries for one platform natively (release smoke gate)

name: vendor:verify-upstream-inputs
description: Fetch and verify the vendored runtime's upstream inputs (npm, Node, Chromium) for every target

name: version:bump
description: Bump plugin version

name: version:read
description: Read plugin version

name: version:write
description: Write plugin version
